    content = f.read()

for name in ['Zone_F4_Z01.Zone_Air_Cooling_Temperature_Setpoint', 'Zone_F4_Z01.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor']:
    # find the block starting with bldg:name
    pattern = r'bldg:' + re.escape(name) + r' \b'
    m = re.search(pattern, content)
    if m:
        s=m.start()
        # capture until next blank line
        end = content.find('\n\n', s)
        print(content[s:end])
        print('===')
